description: cosmos: Search. GET /v1/cosmos/search. Search public Cosmos posts by keyword. Cosmos may return related posts even when there is no exact keyword match. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when items is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cursor.description: Pass the previous response cursor unchanged. Stop when it is null; sending the literal string "null" returns an empty terminal page without fetching or charging.

name: cosmos_search
